licence.renewsTogether.value: A valid lease at renewal. The lease agreement is issued alongside the licence at incorporation.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Hamriyah Free Zone (HFZA), renews together (consultancies, REPORTED; the MOET registrar profile shows the lease issued alongside the licence at incorporation); https://bizstartuae.com/renew-hamriyah-free-zone-license/ ; https://www.moet.gov.ae/documents/20121/416990/Himriyah+ENG.pdf/6ffc4133-c9c7-9dbd-b166-8c2867107a26?t=1631908146890

licence.afterExpiry.value: No licence expiry grace period is stated in an official source. The FZE Unit may deregister an FZE for a breach of the rules or licence terms not remedied within 7 days of written notice, or if it does not answer a written not carrying on business enquiry within 7 days. Daily fines during non-compliance are possible.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Hamriyah Free Zone (HFZA), late renewal (HFZA FZE Implementing Rules arts. 22(C), 24(B) and 25(B), CONFIRMED; these cover deregistration generally, not expiry thresholds. REPORTED only: consultancies say there is no grace period and that long lapses may require re-registration); https://hfza.ae/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/HHFZA_Implementing_Rules_FZE_rev_11_01_16.pdf ; https://bizstartuae.com/renew-hamriyah-free-zone-license/

licence.graceDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Hamriyah Free Zone (HFZA), late renewal (no licence expiry grace period in an official source; consultancies say none); https://hfza.ae/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/HHFZA_Implementing_Rules_FZE_rev_11_01_16.pdf ; https://bizstartuae.com/renew-hamriyah-free-zone-license/
